1. **[Bounded in-process memos](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/caching-and-performance.md#L89)** — [src/modules/billing/routes/billing.service.ts:42](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/a43549a08ebc5dbb84773bae664a37e1c93e0725/src/modules/billing/routes/billing.service.ts#L42) — `warnedUnclassifiedLinkIds` is a new ad hoc in-process memo with neither a cron clear nor a size bound, so it holds one entry per unclassified trial-link id for the whole process lifetime and never re-warns if a catalog is fixed and later re-broken. **Fix:** add an hourly `@Cron` method on `BillingService`, disabled when NODE_ENV is test (the shape `clearSignatureMemo` uses in `src/domain/common/entities/safe-signature.ts`), calling `this.warnedUnclassifiedLinkIds.clear()`; or cap the set size.
2. **[R-006: Asserting that *an* error was thrown, not *which*](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/remarks.md#L128)** — [src/modules/entitlements/routes/entitlements.service.integration.spec.ts:1139](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/a43549a08ebc5dbb84773bae664a37e1c93e0725/src/modules/entitlements/routes/entitlements.service.integration.spec.ts#L1139) — the rewritten assertion is a bare `toThrow()`, which passes for any throw including a TypeError from a typo on the line under test, while the sibling case added in `billing.service.spec.ts` does pin the message. **Fix:** `expect(() => buildService(undefined)).toThrow('No value set for key entitlements.enforcementStartsAt');`

**Verdict:** ❌ 2 finding(s)
